purpose: Transfer one manual BP operation with header and accounting-register movements, preserving Posted/Active and typed subconto.

movements.emptyAmountPolicy: Only explicitly supplied values; no defaults for tax/analytic fields.
movements.activePolicy: Copy Active per row; Posted is copied from the header, not inferred.

validation.references: exists, not marked for deletion, type exactly matches the declared subconto type
validation.subconto: for every used slot, both reference and type are required; empty slots stay empty
validation.amounts: line amount, debit/credit equality and all supplied tax amounts are compared exactly; empty remains empty
validation.readback: re-read document and all register rows by registrar; compare every supplied field before commit

testScenario.name: rollback_on_subconto_type_mismatch
steps: write synthetic header and one movement in a transaction
tamper one subconto type before readback
transaction must roll back: no document, no register rows

standardInterface.preferred: Document_ОперацияБух via standard 1C object API, if its published object has a posting/movement table that writes an unposted document
standardInterface.fallback: Not allowed without an owner-approved standard API; no direct DB writes.
conditions: external processing is enabled in the target infobase
safe mode allows required object writes
the test infobase has the same platform/configuration version
the operation object and accounting register are published/available to the processing
